login.forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter your admin email and we'll send you a reset link.
login.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
login.resetSuccess: Password reset successfully. Redirecting you to login...
login.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

analytics.subtitle: Revenue trends and top-selling products
analytics.incompleteCostData: Some products don't have a cost price set yet, so this profit figure is a partial estimate. Add cost prices in the product form for a fuller picture.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Manage your product catalog
products.dragImages: Click to upload or drag images here
products.costPriceHint: What you paid for this item — internal only, never shown to customers.
products.discountPriceHint: Optional — fill in only if this item is on sale. When set, this is the price charged to the customer and used to calculate margin, instead of the normal price.
products.relatedProductsHint: Shown on the product page above "You may also like" — e.g. link a printer to its ink, paper, and cable.
products.duplicated: Product duplicated — edit the copy below.
products.shortDescriptionHint: Shown under the product name, before the price. 1–2 sentences.
products.shortDescriptionPlaceholderFr: Ex. Imprimante 3-en-1 Wi-Fi, idéale pour la maison et le bureau.
products.shortDescriptionPlaceholderEn: E.g. 3-in-1 Wi-Fi printer, ideal for home and office.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Organize your catalog into categories
categories.imageHint: Shown on the storefront's homepage category grid.
categories.typeColorHint: Shown as a clickable color circle on the storefront — customers pick the color before adding to cart.
categories.orderHint: This is the order the characteristics appear in on the product page. Use ↑ ↓ to change it.

banners.subtitle: Manage the homepage hero banner(s)
banners.hint: The first active banner (by sort order) is shown as the homepage hero. Add more than one to rotate through several.
banners.placementHint: Choose which spot on the storefront this banner is for.
banners.imageHint: Main banner: 1500 × 600 px (5:2) if you have side tiles, otherwise 1920 × 640 px (3:1). Other shapes are shown in full, with blurred edges — nothing is cropped.
banners.placementSide: Tile to the right of the main banner (GIF allowed)
banners.imageHintSide: Side tile: about 600 × 350 px. Animated GIFs are accepted (5 MB max) and stay animated. Up to 2 tiles per side, in display order.
banners.imageHintTile: The image is shown in full inside the tile.
banners.placementSideLeft: Tile to the left of the main banner (GIF allowed)

deliveryZones.subtitle: Set delivery fees per city — shown to customers at checkout
deliveryZones.hint: Customers pick their city from this list at checkout, and the matching fee is added to their order total automatically.
deliveryZones.cityHint: Must match exactly what you want customers to see (e.g. Yaoundé, Douala).
deliveryZones.sortHint: Lower numbers appear first in the checkout dropdown.

account.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.

pwa.title: IT Mart on your phone
pwa.intro: Install the admin as an app and get an alert on this device for every new order and low stock.
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone: tap the Share button in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.installManual: Open the browser menu (⋮) and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
pwa.notifBlocked: Blocked — allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
pwa.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone, install the app to your Home Screen first, then turn on notifications from the app.
pwa.insecure: Installing the app and notifications need a secure connection (HTTPS, or localhost on this computer). See the README for testing on a phone.
pwa.bannerTitle: Get new orders on your phone
pwa.bannerText: Install the app and turn on notifications.
pwa.offline: You are offline — changes can't be saved until the connection is back.

errors.serverNotConfigured: Notifications aren't configured on the server yet (VAPID keys missing in the backend .env).
errors.permissionDenied: Permission refused. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
errors.generic: Couldn't turn on notifications. Please try again.
